messages:
Sam (Events): T-minus 7 minutes. Quick run: deck v4 just landed with a metrics tweak, do we want to hotpatch or slide note?
Priya (Product): If it's just the metric footnote, let's do a single-slide note rather than swapping the whole deck. I'll paste the exact line to add.
Noor (AV): Heads up: preview shows capture-4 has elevated write latency. I'm putting recording onto capture-5 standby and lowering retention buffer for preview viewers.
stream-bot: alert: capture-4 write_latency=254ms at 1767456770
Rory (Eng): On it. Mirroring ingest to capture-5 and throttling preview bitrate: `ingestctl switch --to capture-5 && bitratectl set preview 1800`
Noor (AV): Done. OBS rebind to capture-5, iso recording active. Note: fallback captions feed is ~7s delayed; callers may notice during Q&A.
Sam (Events): Noted. We'll ask Eve to mention caption lag at the top. Also mic check in 3. Eve can you confirm audio on your end?
Eve (CEO): Loud and clear. No hum. I'll call out the caption delay and where to file follow-ups.
Priya (Product): Q for leadership during Q&A: will Reserved Dedicated be listed as GA or pilot in the slide? need exact wording.
Eve (CEO): Use: "Reserved Dedicated: pilot availability now, GA targeted Q3." I'll expand in Q&A.
Rory (Eng): small ops note: archive jobs sometimes trim the last 15s if stop-recorder fires immediately. Recommend stop +120s tail retention for this session.
Sam (Events): Agreed. We'll stop recording +120s after final applause. Also new post-show flow: please file any action items in #allhands-followups and prefix with "ACTION:" plus an owner. We'll triage tomorrow.
Noor (AV): One more AV caveat: when we switch slides mid-demo, OBS scene may drop a frame for ~1s. I'll do a silent scene refresh during the slide transition to avoid viewers seeing the flash.
stream-bot: recording: started capture-5-iso at 1767456795
Sam (Events): Mic-check for presenters: if anyone is on laptop mic, please plug in power or switch to headset to avoid fan noise.
Priya (Product): Sending the tiny slide footnote now: "Note: metric revised post-analysis. See #product for details"
Eve (CEO): I'll mention that and invite product/security followups. Reminder to the team: when routing follow-ups, use tags like "ACTION: security @name" so we can route faster.
Noor (AV): Preview looks stable, viewers normal, stream bitrate 3.0Mbps. Captions secondary is live but delayed; I'll keep primary captions on unless encoder drops.
Rory (Eng): Kicking an archive snapshot scheduled at +130s post-stop to be safe: `archivectl snapshot --after 130s --dest /archives/allhands/1767456789`
Sam (Events): Perfect. Rolling in 2 minutes. Final checklist: 1) mention captions lag 2) mention ACTION: prefix for follow-ups 3) footnote on slide v4 4) stop +120s. Ready?
Priya (Product): Ready.
Noor (AV): Ready, OBS green.
Eve (CEO): Ready. Let's do it. :clap:
